description: List the document's links as the Links panel shows them: name, status, full and platform-style path, URL links, size, date, the item that holds each link, image resolution, InCopy lock state, and optionally the linked file's XMP metadata (Links panel; Link Info; Utilities > XMP File Info; Copy Full Path / Copy Platform Style Path)

includeXmp.description: Include each linked file's XMP metadata (title, author, description, keywords, copyright, dates)

links.description: Which links to act on (rows of the Links panel): link ids or names from list_document_links, the page items whose placed content is linked, the links of the selected items, or every link; status narrows the choice. Default: every link

itemIds.description: Page item ids: the links of the graphics or text placed in these frames

names.description: Link names as the Links panel shows them (every link with each name)

selection.description: The links of the selected items

status.description: Keep only links with these statuses; given alone it chooses among every link

xmpProperties.description: Further XMP properties to read, as { namespace, path } (for example namespace "http://ns.adobe.com/photoshop/1.0/", path "City")

name: list_document_links
title: List Document Links
